playbooks.title: RDP Shortpath UDP transport disabled or falling back to TCP relay
playbooks.bottomLine: Sessions are riding TCP reverse-connect instead of UDP Shortpath because the Intune multi-session Shortpath policy or UDP 3390 path is missing.

citations.claim: Enabling RDP Shortpath over managed and public networks reduces round-trip time and jitter compared to gateway-relayed TCP.
Multi-session hosts require the Intune Settings Catalog RDP Shortpath policy and outbound STUN/TURN reachability.

remediation.name: intune-settings-catalog-shortpath
remediation.blastRadius: Session hosts in the target dynamic host group; active sessions keep their transport until reconnect.
remediation.actionSummary: Enable the Intune Settings Catalog RDP Shortpath profile and verify UDP 3390 listener on session hosts.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore previous Settings Catalog assignment state from rollback snapshot.

playbooks.title: Black screen on connect or immediate session disconnect (0x3000046)
playbooks.bottomLine: The session broker connected the user, but Windows shell initialization stalled due to a hung FSLogix/AppX readiness task or outdated SxS stack.

citations.claim: WVDCheckpoints and LocalSessionManager operational events isolate whether a black screen sits in FSLogix LoadProfile or AppXReadiness.
Stripping required system AppX packages without the reviewed WDOT profile can stall Explorer shell startup.

remediation.name: drain-and-reset-stuck-host-sessions
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (places affected host in drain mode and resets hung session processes)
remediation.blastRadius: Single affected session host; new logons route to healthy hosts in the pool.
remediation.actionSummary: Enable drain mode on the affected host, log off hung ghost sessions, and verify RDAgent/SxS stack status.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Re-enable allowNewSession ($true) on the session host.

playbooks.title: Private Link feed or connection failure from missing Private DNS zone link
playbooks.bottomLine: Private Endpoints are enabled on the workspace or host pool, but the spoke VNet is missing a virtual network link to privatelink.wvd.microsoft.com.

citations.claim: Both privatelink.wvd.microsoft.com and privatelink-global.wvd.microsoft.com must resolve across the session host and client VNets.

remediation.name: enablePrivateLinkDnsLinks
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (links existing Private DNS zones to the spoke VNet)
remediation.blastRadius: DNS resolution for *.wvd.microsoft.com inside the linked VNet.
remediation.actionSummary: Link the Private DNS zones to the session host VNet and verify Private Endpoint connection state is Approved.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Remove the VNet link recorded in the rollback snapshot.

playbooks.title: FSLogix profile mount fails with Access Denied (0x0000052e / 0xC0000022) on Entra-joined host
playbooks.bottomLine: Entra Kerberos is either missing consent on the storage service principal, or Azure Files SMB channel encryption is set to AES-256-GCM only (which rejects Entra Kerberos SESSION_SETUP with 0xC0000022 unless AES-128-GCM is also enabled).

citations.claim: Entra Kerberos on Azure Files is refused with 0xC0000022 at SMB SESSION_SETUP when channel encryption is AES-256-GCM only; enabling AES-128-GCM;AES-256-GCM (CCM off) resolves it (avd-landing-zone lesson 0028).
Cloud-native Entra-joined session hosts mounting Azure Files require Entra Kerberos enabled on the storage account, a Kerberos key generated, and Graph User.Read consented.
CloudKerberosTicketRetrievalEnabled must be set to 1 alongside the storage account service principal consent.

remediation.name: entra-kerberos-consent
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (SMB channelEncryption AES-128-GCM;AES-256-GCM + Entra service principal consent)
remediation.blastRadius: FSLogix storage account SMB settings, service principal, and pool user security group.
remediation.actionSummary: Ensure Azure Files SMB channel encryption includes AES-128-GCM;AES-256-GCM, grant admin consent for User.Read on the storage service principal, and verify SMB share RBAC.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Revert SMB channelEncryption or service principal changes recorded in rollback snapshot.

playbooks.title: FSLogix loads a temporary profile due to an orphaned VHDX lock (Event 26)
playbooks.bottomLine: A disconnected session on another host still holds an exclusive SMB lock on the user's VHDX because idle/disconnected session time limits are not enforced.

citations.claim: Enforcing disconnected session time limits prevents abandoned sessions from holding VHDX locks across host pools.

remediation.name: intune-session-time-limits
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (disconnects stale session and configures Intune session time limits)
remediation.blastRadius: Logs off the single stale disconnected session holding the VHDX lock and sets idle/disconnect policy.
remediation.actionSummary: Log off the stale disconnected user session and apply the Intune Settings Catalog session time limits policy.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore previous Settings Catalog policy assignment.

playbooks.title: Slow logon (>45s) from Azure Files IOPS throttling and Outlook cache bloat
playbooks.bottomLine: FSLogix profile containers are hitting Azure Files IOPS/bandwidth ceilings during logon storms, compounded by unthrottled Outlook cached mode.

citations.claim: Tuning Outlook cached Exchange sync windows and enabling Premium Azure Files burst/provisioned IOPS with SMB Multichannel prevents logon storm stalls.

remediation.name: enableOutlookCachedModeTuning
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 for M365 policy tuning (scaling Azure Files quota requires `go batch <id> $<total>`)
remediation.blastRadius: M365 Apps Outlook profile sync window policy on multi-session hosts.
remediation.actionSummary: Apply the M365 Outlook cached mode sync window baseline via Intune Settings Catalog.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Revert Settings Catalog policy to previous revision.

playbooks.title: Session host status Unavailable or NeedsAssistance (HealthCheck failure)
playbooks.bottomLine: One or more session hosts failed an RDAgent health check (DomainJoinCheck, SxSStackListenerCheck, or UrlsAccessibleCheck) and cannot accept connections.

citations.claim: Session host health check codes identify whether failure is Entra/domain join, SxS listener, or outbound broker reachability.

remediation.name: repair-session-host-agent
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (drains host and restarts Remote Desktop Agent Loader service)
remediation.blastRadius: Target unhealthy session host only (placed in drain mode first).
remediation.actionSummary: Place unhealthy session host in drain mode, restart RDAgentBootLoader via Azure VM RunCommand, and re-verify Status == Available.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Keep host in drain mode for image redeploy if health check remains failed.

playbooks.title: NoAvailableSessionHost error from hosts stuck in drain mode or maxSessionLimit reached
playbooks.bottomLine: All running session hosts are either at maxSessionLimit or left in drain mode (allowNewSession: false).

citations.claim: Hosts left with allowNewSession=false after maintenance are excluded from load balancing and autoscale ramp-up.

remediation.name: clear-stale-drain-mode
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (clears allowNewSession=false on healthy hosts; starting deallocated VMs requires `go batch <id> $<total>`)
remediation.blastRadius: Healthy session hosts currently set to allowNewSession=false.
remediation.actionSummary: Enable allowNewSession on healthy hosts that passed all health checks.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore allowNewSession=false on the hosts listed in the rollback snapshot.

playbooks.title: High CPU or memory contention across multi-session hosts
playbooks.bottomLine: Session hosts are experiencing sustained CPU (>85%) or low available memory due to unoptimized Teams/OneDrive processes or high session density.

citations.claim: Enabling Teams VDI SlimCore/WebRTC offload and capping maxSessionLimit to SKU benchmarks prevents multi-session CPU saturation.
Sustained p95 user input delay above 100 ms or CPU above the 80% target utilization ceiling requires lowering maxSessionLimit or enabling media offload.

remediation.name: enableTeamsVdiOptimization
remediation.blastRadius: Host pool maxSessionLimit and Teams VDI media offload policy.
remediation.actionSummary: Enable Teams VDI media offload policy and align host pool maxSessionLimit with the validated SKU threshold.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore previous maxSessionLimit and policy state.

playbooks.title: Entra SSO sign-in loop or Conditional Access device compliance block (AADSTS53000)
playbooks.bottomLine: Entra Single Sign-On (`enablerdsaadauth:i:1`) is disabled on the host pool or a Conditional Access policy requires device compliance while session hosts are noncompliant.

citations.claim: Entra-joined host pools require enablerdsaadauth:i:1 and Conditional Access policies scoped to AVD app IDs with break-glass exclusions.
AVD Conditional Access policies must enforce MFA while excluding break-glass accounts and aligning with host compliance state.

remediation.name: enableEntraSso
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (host pool RDP property & CA reportOnly/compliance alignment)
remediation.blastRadius: Host pool customRdpProperty and AVD Conditional Access policy.
remediation.actionSummary: Enable enablerdsaadauth:i:1 on the host pool and ensure AVD Conditional Access excludes break-glass accounts and matches Intune compliance state.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore previous customRdpProperty string from rollback snapshot.

playbooks.title: Intune Settings Catalog profile errors or un-enrolled multi-session hosts
playbooks.bottomLine: Session hosts are missing MDM enrollment (`mdmId`), failing Settings Catalog profile application, or marked noncompliant by `secureByDefault`.

citations.claim: Windows Enterprise multi-session hosts must enroll via AADLoginForWindows with mdmId and receive Settings Catalog policies scoped to windowsEnterpriseMultiSession.

remediation.name: intune-settings-catalog-fslogix
remediation.blastRadius: Dynamic session-host device group in Intune.
remediation.actionSummary: Assign the multi-session Settings Catalog baseline and compliance policy to the dynamic session-host group and trigger an Intune device sync.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore previous group assignment on the Settings Catalog profile.

playbooks.title: Missing M365 Shared Computer Activation, OneDrive KFM, or Teams VDI optimization
playbooks.bottomLine: Users hit M365 licensing prompts or unredirected local Desktop/Documents folders because Shared Computer Activation and OneDrive Known Folder Move are not enforced.

citations.claim: Multi-session estates require SharedComputerLicensing=1, OneDrive SilentAccountConfig + KFM, and Teams VDI media optimization.
Microsoft 365 Apps on shared session hosts require Shared Computer Activation enabled.

remediation.name: enableSharedComputerActivation
remediation.blastRadius: M365 Apps, OneDrive, and Teams VDI policy profiles assigned to the AVD host group.
remediation.actionSummary: Enable Shared Computer Activation, OneDrive Silent Account Configuration + KFM, and Teams VDI optimization in the M365 control-plane slice.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Remove or revert the M365 Settings Catalog profile assignments.

playbooks.title: Multi-plane stage handoff drift across Entra, Intune, M365, Azure, and Power Platform
playbooks.bottomLine: One or more stage handoff manifests in the companion estate vault (`entra-manifest.json`, `intune-manifest.json`, `m365-manifest.json`, `azure-outputs.json`, `power-platform-manifest.json`) drifted from live tenant state.

citations.claim: Invoke-AvdControlPlanes.ps1 and avd-current-state verify live state against the five stage handoff manifests and group-only RBAC.

remediation.name: entra-group-rbac-only
remediation.costEstimate: $0.00 (reconciles control-plane settings via C24 remediation plan)
remediation.blastRadius: Drifted control-plane resources identified in C24 plan.
remediation.actionSummary: Export the plane-grouped C24 remediation plan and re-run the affected control-plane stage in avd-landing-zone.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore previous manifest parameters from the companion vault run journal.

playbooks.title: Power Platform day-2 workflow suspended or missing strict DLP and VNet injection
playbooks.bottomLine: AVD day-2 Power Automate workflows are either running in an unisolated environment without a strict DLP policy or missing VNet enterprise policy subnet delegation.

citations.claim: Production AVD day-2 workflows must run in a dedicated environment guarded by a strict DLP policy and VNet enterprise policy.
Power Platform environments executing AVD operations require subnet-delegated VNet enterprise policy egress.

remediation.name: power-platform-strict-dlp
remediation.blastRadius: Dedicated AVD Power Platform environment connector classifications.
remediation.actionSummary: Apply the strict DLP policy (`Default` group `Blocked`) and link the `Microsoft.PowerPlatform/enterprisePolicies` resource to the delegated subnet.
remediation.rollbackSummary: Restore previous DLP connector classification from rollback snapshot.
